name: Duet: Agentic AI & Parallel Consciousness
description: A digital-twin agent that reconstructs a person's worldview and answers in three streams (instinct, reasoning, voice). The /forge command adds PERSONAFORGE: a grounded cast built from one URL, interviewed one persona at a time. Replies are governed by a local MAS layer: Six Hats, EMOJA tone veto, DUNCE failure memory, KUNDALINI staging, and JATAKA guardrails.
